name: Corporate Thriller (India Inc.)
description: Fast-paced thriller set in the boardrooms and tech parks of modern India.

chapters.title: The Unicorn Dream
chapters.description: A booming startup, massive valuations, and toxic work culture.

chapters.title: The Audit
chapters.description: A discrepancy is found; the protagonist stumbles upon a massive fraud.

chapters.title: The Warning
chapters.description: Subtle threats to back off; discovering how deep the rot goes.

chapters.title: The Whistleblower
chapters.description: Reaching out to the media or authorities, but finding them compromised.

chapters.title: The Setup
chapters.description: The protagonist is framed for the very fraud they uncovered.

chapters.title: The Firing
chapters.description: Stripped of power, reputation destroyed, abandoned by colleagues.

chapters.title: The Underground Alliance
chapters.description: Teaming up with a hacker or a disgraced former executive.

chapters.title: Following the Money
chapters.description: Tracing shell companies, hawala networks, and political links.

chapters.title: The Data Heist
chapters.description: Infiltrating the company's servers to get the golden evidence.

chapters.title: The Board Meeting Climax
chapters.description: Confronting the CEO in front of investors with undeniable proof.

chapters.title: The Fallout
chapters.description: The company crashes, arrests are made, but the money is gone.

chapters.title: The Next Venture
chapters.description: The protagonist starts over, older and much wiser.
